# graviteeam_plugins (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM platform plugin catalogs, plugin details, plugin configuration schemas, or plugin documentation

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_plugins" "identity_providers" {
  category = "identities"
}

data "graviteeam_plugins" "http_identity_provider_schema" {
  category  = "identities"
  plugin_id = "http-am-idp"
  schema    = true
}

data "graviteeam_plugins" "policy_documentation" {
  category      = "policies"
  plugin_id      = "groovy"
  documentation = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Plugin category, such as identities, factors, certificates, resources, reporters, policies, or notifiers

### Optional

- `documentation` (Boolean) Whether to read the selected plugin documentation. Requires plugin_id and is currently supported for policy plugins.
- `plugin_id` (String) Optional plugin ID. When omitted, the data source reads the plugin catalog for the category.
- `schema` (Boolean) Whether to read the selected plugin configuration schema. Requires plugin_id.

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the plugin catalog, plugin details, plugin schema, plugin documentation, or null when the API returns no content
